verses.1: Give praise to the LORD, for he is good, for his steadfast love is eternal.
verses.2: Let Israel say, for his steadfast love is eternal.
verses.3: Let the house of Aaron say, for his steadfast love is eternal.
verses.4: Let those who fear the LORD say, for his steadfast love is eternal.
verses.5: From my distress I called to the LORD— the LORD answered me in the wide open.
verses.6: The LORD is my help. I will not fear what any human may do to me.
verses.7: The LORD is my help. I will look down upon my enemies.
verses.8: It is better to take refuge in the LORD than to trust in any human.
verses.9: It is better to take refuge in the LORD than to trust in mighty nobles.
verses.10: All the nations surrounded me, but in the name of the LORD I drove them back.
verses.11: They surrounded me, they surrounded me, but in the name of the LORD I drove them back.
verses.12: They swarmed like bees, they burned like a fire of thorns, but in the name of the LORD I drove them back.
verses.13: I was pushed hard to fall, but the LORD upheld me.
verses.14: The LORD is my strength and my praise, and he has become my salvation.
verses.15: The voice of joy and salvation is in the tents of the righteous. The right hand of the LORD does mighty deeds.
verses.16: The right hand of the LORD is raised, the right hand of the LORD does mighty deeds.
verses.17: I will not die, but I will live, and I will declare the works of the LORD.
verses.18: The LORD disciplined me, but did not give me over to death.
verses.19: Open to me the gates of righteousness; I will enter them, to give thanks to the LORD.
verses.20: This is the gate of the LORD— the righteous shall enter through it.
verses.21: I will give thanks to you, for you answered me and became my salvation.
verses.22: The stone that the builders rejected has become the chief cornerstone.
verses.23: This came from the LORD— it is wondrous in our eyes.
verses.24: This is the day the LORD has made; let us rejoice and be glad in it.
verses.25: O LORD, I beg you, save. O LORD, I beg you, grant success.
verses.26: Blessed is the one who comes in the name of the LORD. We bless you from the house of the LORD.
verses.27: God is the LORD, and he has shone upon us. Arrange the feast with branches reaching to the horns of the altar.
verses.28: You are my God, and I will give thanks to you; you are my God, and I will praise you. I will give thanks, for you answered me and became my salvation.
verses.29: Give praise to the LORD, for he is good, for his steadfast love is eternal.

notes:
Notes  
- v. 29: The final verse mirrors the first and serves as a refrain, emphasizing the eternal steadfast love of the LORD.
